title: SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination
abstract: arXiv:2611.33467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce S

translated_title: SplatWAM：用于实时3D想象的溅射世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型通常在像素空间或潜空间中预测未来观测，这限制了它们直接表示真实3D场景演化的能力。我们提出了SplatWAM（溅射世界动作模型），这是一种生成式世界模型，直接在紧凑的3D高斯基元上学习动作条件下的动力学。分词器SplatWAM-T首先将可变数量的无位姿视角图像编码为固定预算的高斯token。随后，动力学模型SplatWAM-D针对每个动作通过单次前向传播预测未来的高斯状态，并利用对数欧几里得协方差坐标和可微渲染监督来促进在显式3D空间中的学习。每个预测状态都可以从任意视角进行光栅化渲染，从而在结构上保证了跨视角共享的3D表示。在OGBench Scene基准上，SplatWAM渲染新视角的速度比视频世界模型快12倍（在RTX 5090上约为80 FPS），同时PSNR最高提升2.0 dB。我们进一步引入了S……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SplatWAM是一种直接在3D高斯基元上学习动作条件动力学的生成式世界模型，通过分词器与动力学模型实现单次前向传播的3D状态预测，可从任意视角实时渲染，速度比视频世界模型快12倍且精度更高。
en_tdlr: SplatWAM is a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives, enabling single-pass prediction of future 3D states that can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints in real time—12x faster than video world models with higher PSNR.
